Return shape exactly (n_origins, output_len); power >= 0.
"""
import numpy as np


def forecast(train_series, history_windows, feature_cols, target_col, input_len, output_len):
    w, t = feature_cols.index("Wspd"), feature_cols.index(target_col)
    bins = np.linspace(0, 25, 51)
    bin_idx = np.digitize(train_series["Wspd"], bins)
    curve = train_series.groupby(bin_idx)[target_col].mean()
    
    # Calculate base based on recent window average wind speed to smooth noise
    avg_w = np.mean(history_windows[:, -12:, w], axis=1)
    base = np.array([curve.get(b, curve.mean()) for b in np.digitize(avg_w, bins)])
    
    # Calculate recent bias using vectorized lookup
    curve_vals = np.array([curve.get(i, curve.mean()) for i in range(len(bins) + 1)])
    recent_w_bins = np.digitize(history_windows[:, -12:, w], bins)
    recent_dev = np.mean(history_windows[:, -12:, t] - curve_vals[recent_w_bins], axis=1)
    # Decay the bias over the output horizon
    decay = np.linspace(1.0, 0.1, output_len)
    preds = base[:, None] + (recent_dev[:, None] * decay[None, :])
    return np.clip(preds, 0.0, None)
